events.title: Sonder Brisbane Language Exchange
events.description: A casual, recurring community meetup where locals and international visitors gather to practice foreign languages over food and drinks. It is designed for organic conversation and cross-cultural connection in a relaxed, non-corporate environment.

events.title: Clancestry Festival (workshops & theatre program)
events.description: A celebration of First Nations storytelling through a curated program of theatre performances and hands-on cultural workshops. The festival emphasizes creative expression and community knowledge sharing within the arts precinct.
